description.en:
Returns whether a player's Fighting Spirit is currently out on the pitch ("avater" is the game's spelling of avatar).
It looks the player up among the match players by parameter ID and reads their Fighting Spirit flag. That flag is set when the Fighting Spirit is summoned (CMND_BTL_SET_AVATER does this) and cleared when it goes away. CMND_BTL_GET_AVATER_NUM counts the same flag over a whole team.
Parameter ID of the player, e.g. "para_cp0008".

true if the player's Fighting Spirit is out.
false if it is not, or if no match player has that ID.
null if the script system is not ready or no argument was given.

examples.case: Dismissing one of the team's Fighting Spirits unless a given player's is already out (real usage, from btl0014.nut)
